purpose: Qualify a previous statement with a relevant caveat.
keywords: Anyone may attend. Reservations are required, though.
You can walk there, though it takes about an hour.
He is good at cooking, although he does not make sweets.
restrictions: Introduces an exception, limitation, or corrective afterthought.
mistake: Distinguish conjunction もっとも from 最も “most”.

segments.role: Qualify a previous statement with a relevant caveat. もっとも + sentence

examples.translation: Anyone may attend. Reservations are required, though.
examples.note: Adds a requirement to a broad statement.
